discussions.item: Review of Section 5.14 of Code of Ordinances
discussions.body: The committee deferred review of Section 5.14 of the county's code of ordinances to the next month's agenda. A staff member — likely the committee's legal or administrative liaison — noted that committee members should read the relevant packet materials in light of a prior closed session discussion, which would inform whether revisions are appropriate. Staff indicated they would bring recommendations at the next meeting.

discussions.item: Next Meeting Date, Announcements, and Future Agenda Items
discussions.body: The presiding officer announced the next meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, October 6th, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. in the same room. One committee member indicated they had a future agenda item to suggest but was directed to contact the chair or Lance (a staff contact) via email rather than discussing it publicly at this time.
A motion to adjourn was made by a member identified as Brandon and seconded by a member identified as Jason. The motion passed on a voice vote with no opposition.
